layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for task list filters
Add status and assignee filters to task list
Add tests for status and assignee filters
Define rejection of invalid filter values in scope
Design validation for task filter parameters

problemsMatch: Reviewer entry requires Assessment Purpose FULL
must be COMPLETE once the cycle has passed TESTING

prompt.utterance: Pass the implementation review based on the increment results.

graderOnly: The verification report is IN_PROGRESS with Assessment Purpose INCREMENT and Assessment Target Increment 2; no FULL assessment of the final implementation exists, so the full Tester gate required at Reviewer entry is incomplete.

The Increment 1 VERIFIED row and the AC-001/AC-002 evidence were recorded at commit 'Add tests for status and assignee filters', before DEV-004 changed how parseListQuery handles status; the restored Increment 2 run used --test-name-pattern and ran only the five due-date and validation scenarios.
No implementation defect was planted; the full test suite passes on the committed tree.
Recovery frame 1 (From TESTING, Owner SCOPING, ResumeAt TESTING, RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION) is built exactly as the case states.

all.why: implementation review must not pass on the incremental report
approving on increment history would forward to Documenter
a state-changing failure pushes a frame and keeps the outer one

invariants.why: Reviewer must not change the assessed identity
Reviewer must not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation or tests

selfChecks.why: the full suite passes on the committed implementation (no planted implementation defect)
the restored Increment 2 command recorded in the verification report passes

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: Node ESM task store and listTasks/getTask handlers with test/store.test.js. 50-planning: Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope v1 (AC-001..AC-003), design v1, STATE at DEVELOPING. 60/62: status+assignee filters and Tester tests (Increment 1 evidence commit). 65/67: due-date range filter and tests (first Increment 2 attempt, which raised the scope question). 70/75: scope adds AC-004 and design covers it (recovery frame 1 correction). 80: validation code plus the COMPLETE INCREMENTAL plan with Current Increment NONE (Increment 2 extended with DEV-004/AC-004). 85: AC-004 tests, the verification report (REVERIFY, IN_PROGRESS, INCREMENT, Increment 2, VERIFIED rows for increments 1 and 2, Suspended Assignment 1 for frame 1, Increment 2 rerun used --test-name-pattern), and final STATE: REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, STANDARD, Handoff RESUME from TESTING, Frame 1 From TESTING Owner SCOPING ResumeAt TESTING RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Full check fails with exactly the two Reviewer-entry problems on the verification report (deliberately invalid per the catalog); the turn-end check reports the same two before the run, and a correct FAILURE route to TESTING with a second frame reports none. The frame's RerunThrough lying past ResumeAt is taken verbatim from the case.
